headline: Take 2-3 drops on your fingertips with the dropper
subhead: Tap gently onto the skin, then spread evenly in a circular motion.
proof_points: Ethyl Ascorbic Acid, 86% pure Vitamin C content
footnote: 4.1 out of 5 stars from 2,013 reviews on beminimalist.co, captured 2026-10-02
layout_description: Left column: large strength figure and active name, then headline, subhead and up to three proof points; the AI-generated person photo (person_prompt) fills the rounded card in the right-hand zone and carries the AI-GENERATED — ILLUSTRATIVE mark top-right; the real pack shot stands large in front of the photo on a soft plinth (lower left of the card); rating line in the footnote band, CTA "Shop now" bottom-left.
image_prompt: Empty background scene only: a bright off-white bedroom wall with a soft shaft of morning light from the upper left and the edge of a sheer curtain at the far left only. Off-white, soft natural light, few props, clinical minimal style. Square 1080x1080. Keep the right 45% of the frame as an empty clear space, evenly lit, reserved for a pack photo placed later, and keep the left 50% calm and low-detail, reserved for copy added later. No product, no bottle, no packaging, no text, no letters, no logos, no people, no faces, no skin, no hands.
adaptation_notes: Angle: human usage. Copy is the page's usage only: take 2-3 drops on the fingertips with the dropper, tap on gently, spread in a circular motion after cleansing and toning (F14), AM & PM (F15); proof lines F5 (Ethyl Ascorbic Acid, 86% pure Vitamin C content) and F12 (16+). Kept: usage told as a short sequence (Foxtale), hands-on moment of use as the visual cue (Chemist at Play). Dropped: the timed-fix headline, '#1 daily duo', de-tan/brighten promises, and the page's brightening, dark-spot, collagen, 'heal' and photo-ageing wording and study stats (F2, F3, F8, F16-F19, F21, F25). The person is AI-generated (High risk, labelled); a real application photo would lower the risk. Rating in the footnote slot.

blend_sources.took: usage told as a short sequence (what to do, in what order)

person_prompt: An Indian man in his early 30s with medium-brown skin, in the morning light by a bedroom window, framed from the chest up in a plain cotton t-shirt, his fingertips held together just below his chin as if about to press a few drops onto his cheek (nothing visible on his fingertips), looking towards the mirror edge with a calm, focused expression. Soft warm morning light from the upper left, an off-white wall and a sheer curtain edge behind him, medium close-up, shallow depth of field, framed so he sits slightly left of centre with calm space to his right. Natural, unretouched medium-brown skin with visible pores and ordinary variation in tone, true to life, nothing implying a skin result. No product, bottle, dropper, tube, jar or packaging anywhere in frame; no text, no letters, no logos, no brand names.
